passages: NOAA deploys new generation of AI-driven global weather models News from Members 17 December 2025 NOAA has launched a groundbreaking new suite of operational, artificial intelligence (AI)-driven global weather prediction models, marking a significant advancement in forecast speed, efficiency, and accuracy.

Share: News was produced by: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) “NOAA’s strategic application of AI is a significant leap forward in American weather model innovation,” said Neil Jacobs, Ph.D., NOAA administrator.
